comment: Independent wizard-mode ^V ? menu travel to the Plane of Earth (page 3, N), with the arrival messages and the Amulet wish dismissed. In the endgame the single-page menu lists only the Elemental Planes, and the dummy level is unreachable (dungeon.c unreachable_level()) but keeps letter f. Pressing f ends the menu with nothing done and a blank message line; ':' follows.
